title: Projections projection definition
description: A projection: an extractor, an optional comparator and a renderer, with their configuration.

upstream.description: Built-in extractions the command builds on, by name. The runner extracts each from the examined revision first, with the definition's scope and timeout, and passes them in the request's `upstream`, keyed by the same names.

comparator.description: How changes are matched, explained and ordered. A string or an object with `file` names a custom comparator file (`<name>.comparator.yaml`); an object without `file` is the default comparator, with its options. Omitted, the default comparator with no options.

anyOf.description: A custom comparator: its comparator file, with options it reads as `options` and any other files it depends on.
The default comparator, with its options. An object without `file` is always the default comparator.

scope.description: Files and directories the extractor reads, not globs, relative to the definition's project: `.` is the project itself, and leading `../` segments widen a nested project's scope beyond it. Optional and enforced where reads are mediated; the default is the whole repository, or a nested project's own directory.

path.description: Relative to the definition's project (the directory holding its `.github/projections` or `.projections`); leading `../` segments leave a nested project.

upstream.description: A built-in extractor, with its inputs, whose extraction of the same revision the command receives.

comparatorFile.description: A comparator file (`<name>.comparator.yaml` or `.comparator.yml`), relative to the definition's project: the custom comparator, run sandboxed over the default comparator.

determinism.description: How reproducible the extraction is, like a test's, declared and never enforced: `pure`, a function of the revision's files (cached by tree, and a rerun must match); `environmental`, the files plus the toolchain and dependencies (cached only within one environment; the default for custom extractors); `observed`, live or varying data such as timings or coverage (never reused silently).

kindPresentation.description: How viewers present one extraction kind.

color.description: The color its items take where a renderer colors by kind: a meaning (`danger`, `warning`, `success`, `info`, `neutral`) or a categorical hue. Renderers paint it with theme tokens.

noun.description: The words for one item and for any other count, such as `{"singular": "hidden key", "plural": "hidden keys"}`.

kinds.description: How viewers present extraction kinds, keyed by kind: a color for renderers that color items by kind, and the summary bar's noun. A kind's key also names the flag of that name (`data.flags`) where a renderer draws flags.

presentation.description: Initial host and renderer settings for viewers. Viewers can still change them.

highlighting.description: Change highlighting: fading with the transition, always, or off.

mode.description: Initial comparison mode; hosts use it only when the renderer supports it.

durationMs.description: Playback duration from before to after at 1× speed, in milliseconds. Omitted, it scales with the number of steps.

rendererOptions.description: Initial values of the renderer's declared controls, keyed by control ID. Hosts ignore unknown IDs and invalid values, with a notice.
